items.question: Roughly how long after the blaze broke out aboard the Cuyahoga in Ashtabula was the same ship found partly filled with water at its Ashtabula berth?
items.expected_answer: About one year and three days: the fire broke out on March 15, 2024, and the flooding was discovered on March 18, 2025.

evidence.quote: On March 15, 2024, about 1315 local time, the bulk carrier Cuyahoga was undergoing maintenance while docked in Ashtabula, Ohio, when a fire broke out in a cargo hold where hot work was being conducted
On March 18, 2025, about 1600 local time, the bulk carrier Cuyahoga was discovered partially flooded while docked in Ashtabula, Ohio

items.notes: Tests linking the two Cuyahoga reports and computing the interval between the fire and the flooding discovery.

items.question: How many people were aboard the Cuyahoga at the time of its 2024 blaze, and how does that headcount differ from the 2025 incident in which it took on water?
items.expected_answer: There were 40 people aboard during the fire (15 crewmembers and 25 maintenance personnel), whereas nobody was aboard when the flooding occurred.

evidence.quote: Persons on board 40 (15 crewmembers; 25 maintenance personnel)

items.notes: Tests comparing the persons-on-board entries from the casualty summary tables of the two Cuyahoga reports.
